resources.name: public-apis
resources.purpose: Discover public API and MCP server candidates by category.
resources.auth: Not applicable to the directory; individual providers vary.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Git repository / Markdown catalog; not a callable API endpoint.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Not applicable to the directory; individual providers vary.
compatible_work_ids: ROOM-HOP-wide discovery; individual integrations must name their owning Work
constraints: Catalog listing does not prove provider availability, safety, cost, license, or compatibility.
Repository MIT license does not replace individual provider terms.
Do not store credentials in W116.

resources.name: SSI FastConnect API
resources.purpose: Vietnam equities market data, OHLCV, indices, corporate actions, WebSocket streaming; the same platform also documents account and order-management operations.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: REST JSON and WebSocket; documented SDKs include Python, Node.js, Java, C#, Go.
resources.auth: API Key + Secret; JWT. Trading token requires OTP.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Registration and access conditions apply; inspect current SSI terms and rate-limit headers.
compatible_work_ids: Owning market-data/integration Work to be assigned
constraints: Separate read-only market-data scope from trading scope.
Trading endpoints can place/amend/cancel orders and access account data; do not enable or expose them to general Agents.
Never store API secrets or OTP in W116 or Git.

resources.name: FRED API
resources.purpose: Retrieve macroeconomic and financial time series from FRED and ALFRED, including series observations, releases, vintages and revisions.
resources.pricing_or_quota: API key registration; check current service limits.
constraints: Record series ID, units, frequency, seasonal adjustment, observation date and release/vintage context.
Do not treat revised historical data as the originally published value.

resources.name: SEC EDGAR APIs
resources.purpose: Access public company submissions, filing histories and XBRL company facts for fundamental and regulatory research.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: HTTPS JSON APIs and EDGAR filing data.
resources.auth: No API key for public data; clients must identify themselves with a compliant User-Agent.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Public access; comply with SEC fair-access guidance and current request limits.
constraints: Respect SEC fair-access rules and request throttling.
Parse XBRL contexts, units, periods and amendments carefully; filings are not investment recommendations.

resources.name: CCXT
resources.purpose: Unified library for public market data across 100+ crypto exchanges; supports tickers, order books, trades and OHLCV. Also exposes private account and trading methods.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP, C#, Go, Java and Rust; REST and exchange-specific WebSocket support.
resources.auth: Public market-data methods often need no key; private account/trading methods require exchange-specific credentials.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Open-source MIT; exchange rate limits and product/API conditions apply.
constraints: Private API methods include orders, transfers and withdrawals; keep disabled for general Agents.
Respect per-exchange rate limits, terms, geography and product availability.
Never store exchange keys in W116.

resources.name: fin-data-mcp
resources.purpose: Community MCP server describing a unified surface over equity, options, FX, crypto, commodities, macroeconomic and filing sources.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: MCP server; repository describes TypeScript implementation and multiple provider adapters.
resources.auth: Varies by provider; some sources public, optional providers require API keys.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Depends on upstream provider and optional credentials.
compatible_work_ids: Potential finance research Agent after code/security review
constraints: At inspection repository showed 4 stars and 1 commit; treat as low-maturity candidate, not production-ready.
Audit dependencies, code, provider behavior, licensing and tests before installing.
No trading or private account permissions.

resources.name: awesome-finance-mcp
resources.purpose: Discover MCP servers for finance Agents, including market data, trading research and financial-data connectors.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: GitHub Markdown directory; not an executable MCP endpoint.
resources.auth: Not applicable to directory; individual projects vary.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Not applicable to directory; individual projects vary.
constraints: Directory listing does not establish maintenance, safety, licensing, provider availability or production readiness.

resources.name: Frankfurter API
resources.purpose: Retrieve historical and current reference exchange rates sourced from central-bank data, including ECB reference rates.
resources.auth: No API key according to public documentation.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Public service; verify current limits and data update schedule.
constraints: Reference rates are not necessarily executable trading quotes or intraday rates.
Store source date and base/quote currency.

resources.name: World Bank Indicators API
resources.purpose: Retrieve cross-country development and macro indicators, including GDP and other economic series.
resources.auth: Public indicator endpoints generally do not require an API key.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Public API; verify current service conditions.
constraints: Check indicator definitions, units, country coverage, frequency and publication lag.
